caption: The product modulator shifts the 0-3 kHz audio band to a 100 kHz carrier. The filter keeps the full upper sideband and a 0.5 kHz vestige of the lower sideband, so the VSB output occupies 3.5 kHz.

spec.title: SSB or VSB by filtering
spec.aria: A 0-3 kHz audio band and a 100 kHz carrier enter a product modulator; a band-pass filter keeps the upper sideband and a 0.5 kHz vestige to produce SSB or VSB.
